head: Jitless plays your PC and classic iOS games on iPhone and iPad
dek: Jitless keeps your PC and classic iOS games in one library and lets you play them with touch, a controller or a keyboard and mouse. It was #8 among paid Entertainment apps on the US App Store on 11 November.
details: You can map buttons, use phone tilt or add a touchpad, with different setups per game. It costs $4.99 with no in-app purchases, by Tomer Cohen, and needs iOS 17.
means: Games you already own may run on your iPhone with controls you set up yourself.
todo: Find Jitless in the App Store and check which of your games it supports.
